name: homestro_product_search
description: Search the Homestro Shopify catalog and return products with title, status, price, category, tags, variants, images, SEO and collections.

name: homestro_read_variants
description: Read one Homestro product including every variant, selected option values, SKUs and assigned images before changing anything.

name: homestro_price_check
description: Check Homestro economics: supplier cost must be <= 12 EUR and selling price must be >= 3x supplier cost. There is no fixed minimum selling price.

name: homestro_create_draft
description: Create a German Shopify product draft. Always DRAFT; never publishes.

name: homestro_optimize_product
description: Fully optimize an existing Homestro product while keeping it DRAFT. Read variants first, directly rename verified variant option values, preserve images, and verify mutations.

option_values.description: Verified variant option values to set directly. Preserve images.

inputSchema.name: homestro_catalog_autopilot_run
inputSchema.description: Start the Homestro Railway 24/7 catalog processor. Railway scans the Shopify catalog, evaluates products against cost <= 12 EUR and selling price >= 3x cost, optimizes qualifying products in German, and keeps products DRAFT.

inputSchema.name: homestro_catalog_autopilot_status
inputSchema.description: Read the live Homestro Railway autopilot status, including running state, last run, processed, rejected, failed and error counts.
